page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical AMD EPYC 9T24 cores running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core processing, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core tests, falls within the average range. A notable performance tradeoff is observed in memory bandwidth; while cached small-block reads perform at an average level, uncached large-block read-only memory bandwidth is weak, placing in the bottom 25% of tested servers.

Given its high memory density and dedicated AMD EPYC processor, this instance provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The combination of strong single-core performance and 128.0 GB of RAM makes it suitable for database operations, caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
